title: Live The Moment
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Can you feel the wind on your face?
Can you see the light in this place?
We are drifting through time and space
Leaving behind the endless race

[Pre-Chorus]
When the music starts to play
All the shadows fade away
We are here, we are now
Let the sound show you how

[Chorus]
Live the moment, don't let it pass you by
Look up high into the endless summer sky
This is our time, this is our place
Holding onto this saving grace

[Drop]
Live the moment!
Yeah, feel the power!

title: Tonight
lyrics:
[Monologue]
As the sun goes down, a new world begins.
The city breathes a different air, a pulse of energy that connects us all.
We don't look back at what was left behind.
We only look forward to the sound.

[Pre-Chorus]
Because tonight, the world is ours.
We are matching the speed of the stars.

[Chorus]
Tonight, we bring the noise
Listen to the collective voice
Tonight, we take control
Deep inside your very soul

[Drop]
Tonight!
Bring the noise!

title: Zombie
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Another head hangs lowly
Child is slowly taken
And the violence causes silence
Who are we mistaken?

[Pre-Chorus]
But you see, it's not me
It's not my family
In your head, in your head, they are fighting
With their tanks and their bombs
And their bombs and their guns
In your head, in your head, they are crying

[Chorus]
In your head, in your head
Zombie, zombie, zombie-ie-ie
What's in your head, zombie?

[Drop]
In your head!
Zombie!

title: Our Church
lyrics:
[Monologue]
We gather here from different paths, driven by the same untamed spirit.
This is not just a dancefloor. This is our temple, our sanctuary.
When the bass line hits, we bow our heads to the kick.

[Pre-Chorus]
This is our sound, this is our ground
Lost in the rhythm that we found
Raise your hands to the sky
We will never let this die

[Chorus]
This is our church!
This is where we belong!

[Drop]
This is our church!
Bow your head!

title: Lose My Mind
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I sit alone in a crowded room
Waiting for the speaker walls to boom
The weight of the world is on my chest
But the melody gives my spirit rest

[Pre-Chorus]
I hear it coming from deep within
A storm of sound about to begin
There's no running, no place to hide
Just let the power swell inside

[Chorus]
Without the music, I would lose my mind
Leaving all reality far behind
It takes me high, it sets me free
This is my identity

[Drop]
I lose my mind!
Let the bass go!

title: Dragonborn
lyrics:
[Monologue]
From the ashes of the old world, a warrior rises.
Bearing the blood of the dragon, chosen by the prophecy of old.
When the sky tears open, the voice will shake the mountains.

[Pre-Chorus]
Beware his power, beware his cry
Written across the burning sky

[Chorus]
He is the Dragonborn!
Fus Ro Dah!

[Drop]
Fus Ro Dah!
Unleash the dragon!

title: Darkest Hour (The Clock
lyrics:
[Monologue]
Tick, tock. The seconds are slipping away.
We are trapped inside the mechanism of time, waiting for the final strike.
But in our darkest hour, we find our ultimate strength.

[Pre-Chorus]
Listen to the clock strike twelve
Into the darkness we must delve
There is no turning back the hands
As the final wall expands

[Chorus]
This is our darkest hour!
Face the power of the clock!

[Drop]
Tick tock!
Face the power!

title: Imaginary
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I paint a picture in my head of a place where we can run
Beyond the stars, beyond the clouds, into the rising sun
No gravity can hold us down, no chains can bind our hands
We are the rulers of the night inside these golden lands

[Pre-Chorus]
Close your eyes and let it take control
A secret kingdom inside your soul

[Chorus]
We live inside an imaginary world
Where the banners of our dreams are unfurled
We fly so high, we never fall
Answering the magic call

[Drop]
Imaginary!
Welcome to my world!

title: Gravity
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They tried to pull me to the ground, tried to keep me in the dark
But they forgot that in my chest lives an everlasting spark
I break the boundaries of the earth, I rise above the stone
Flying upward to the stars to claim my rightful throne

[Pre-Chorus]
No weight can hold my spirit back
We are moving on a light-speed track

[Chorus]
Breaking the laws of gravity
This is what it means to be free

[Drop]
Break gravity!
Fly!

title: The Solution
lyrics:
[Monologue]
In a world blinded by chaos and confusion, we search for a sign.
A frequency that cuts through the noise and repairs the broken connection.
We found the answer in the rhythm. We found the cure in the core.

[Pre-Chorus]
This is the healing of the blind
A state of elevated mind

[Chorus]
We have found the solution
Join the sonic revolution

[Drop]
The solution!
Activate the kick!

title: Trip To Mars
lyrics:
[Monologue]
Prepare for countdown. Ten, nine, eight... 
We are leaving the atmosphere behind, accelerating into the cosmic void.
Destination: the red planet. Destination: maximum distortion.

[Pre-Chorus]
Blast off into the endless night
Moving at the speed of light

[Chorus]
Take a trip to Mars!
Dancing underneath the stars!

[Drop]
Countdown... Blast off!
Welcome to Mars!

title: Legends Never Die
lyrics:
[Monologue]
They can burn our cities, they can tear down our monuments.
But they can never erase the marks we left upon the history of sound.
What we create in this room echoes through eternity.

[Pre-Chorus]
Write our names in pillars of stone
We will never walk alone

[Chorus]
Legends never die!
We will echo through the sky!

[Drop]
Legends never die!
For eternity!

title: Fallen Souls
lyrics:
[Monologue]
From the deepest depths of the underworld, the shadows begin to crawl.
An army of distorted frequencies rising to reclaim the surface.
Listen closely to the screaming of the sub-bass.

[Pre-Chorus]
When the darkness takes control
We will capture every soul

[Chorus]
Rise up, fallen souls!
Let the madness take control!

[Drop]
Fallen souls!
Embrace the madness!

title: Accelerate
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I feel the heat against my skin, the engine starts to roar
We are moving faster than we've ever done before
No red lights can stop us now, no brakes can hold the wheels
Just ride the wave of energy and show them how it feels

[Pre-Chorus]
Push the needle past the red
Forget the words they ever said

[Chorus]
Accelerate the speed of sound
Lift your feet up off the ground

[Drop]
Accelerate!
Go fast!

title: One Tribe (Defqon.1 Anthem)
lyrics:
[Monologue]
We are gathered here from all corners of the earth.
Speaking different languages, but beating to the exact same drum.
Tonight, we are no longer individuals. Tonight, we are one entity.

[Pre-Chorus]
Raise the flags into the air
Feel the magic everywhere

[Chorus]
We are one tribe!
Driven by the heavy vibe!

[Drop]
One tribe!
Defqon.1!

title: The Power of the Mind
lyrics:
[Monologue]
Your eyes are getting heavy. You can no longer resist the command of the frequency.
Reality is turning into an illusion, controlled entirely by the sequence.
Unlock the deep chambers of your consciousness.

[Pre-Chorus]
Lose control of your design
Surrender to the baseline

[Chorus]
Discover the power of the mind
Leave your physical form behind

[Drop]
The power of the mind!
Deconstruct reality!

title: Psychadelic
lyrics:
[Monologue]
Colors are blending with sounds. The walls are beginning to breathe.
You have entered the psychedelic vortex, where the kick drum dictates your heartbeat.
Do not try to fight the hallucination.

[Pre-Chorus]
Lost inside the cosmic spiral
This translation is viral

[Chorus]
Welcome to the psychedelic show
Let your inner madness grow

[Drop]
Psychedelic!
Open your mind!

title: Faye
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When the world gets dark and cold, you're the fire in my hand
The only piece of sanity that I can understand
I would walk through burning coal just to see your smiling face
You're my home, my anchor point inside this crazy place

[Pre-Chorus]
When the bass drum starts to pound
I will lift you off the ground

[Chorus]
Faye, I'll never let you fall into the deep
This is the sacred promise that I keep

[Drop]
I'll never let you fall!
Faye!

title: Beast Mode
lyrics:
[Monologue]
No pain, no gain. The weight is heavy, but your resolve is iron.
Strip away the weakness, unleash the predator hiding inside your DNA.
It's time to break the chains.

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel the adrenaline ignite
We are breaking through tonight

[Chorus]
Activate beast mode!
Let the chamber explode!

[Drop]
Beast mode!
Break the chains!

title: Halo
artist: Sub Zero Project feat. Diandra Faye
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I see an angel standing right on top of the wall
She is watching over us, waiting for the call
Her wings are made of light, cutting through the heavy smoke
Breaking the dark curse that the ancient executioner spoke

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel the heavens open wide
With the power by our side

[Chorus]
I can see your shining halo in the night
Guiding us forward to the ultimate fight

[Drop]
I see your halo!
Fight!
